claims.evidence: Paper: 'two standard bovine glycoproteins (alpha-1-acid glycoprotein and fetuin)'
File names (HCD_15/25/35/15_35), RAW method names (NCE15, NCE25, NCE35, NCE15_35) and paper stepped NCE 15, 25, 35
Same standard injected at different NCE settings, numbered in sorted file-name order; no deposited replicate mapping
RAW headers (Method of Q Exactive); embedded paths match file names for all 5

claims.value: Trypsin; 10 ppm/0.05 Da; Carbamidomethyl, Oxidation, Glyco_Fuc_HexNAc
claims.evidence: RB_161031_Aplha1acid_HCD_15.dat header (CLE, TOL, ITOL, MODS, IT_MODS); paper: standards digested with trypsin

claims.value: 0.1 Da; Carbamidomethyl fixed + Oxidation variable; no Glyco_Fuc_HexNAc
claims.evidence: Deposited RB_161031_Fetuin_HCD_15_35.dat header (ITOL=0.1, DB=O-GlyStandard, variable Oxidation (M) only) per independent reviewer; the alpha-1-acid glycoprotein rows use 0.05 Da and Glyco_Fuc_HexNAc from their own .dat

limitations: Standards' sample preparation (reduction/alkylation, supplier) is not described in the paper text read; organism part, developmental stage, strain and sex are not applicable/not available.
Alpha-1-acid files with different NCE are labelled technical replicates 1-4 only to keep rows unique; they are distinct acquisition settings, not true replicates.
The deposit contains no archives (.zip/.tar); only individual RAW files were claimed (29 RAW: 24 serum, 5 standards, each exactly once).
Glyco_Fuc_HexNAc (Mascot custom modification on the residue code O = HexNAc, 'fucose addition on HexNAc') has no Unimod entry; written without AC.
Reduction/alkylation reagents and enrichment process (TiO2) are described in the paper but not encoded (optional columns, ontology terms not verified).
